manifest.name: dsh-library
manifest.description: 每个工作区自动建一个资料库，统一放在你选定的本机位置；在「资料库」菜单里集中管理，任意格式文件都能导入，原件只复制不改来源。对话中可随时选择是否参考资料库。

readme.section: DSH 资料库 · 把项目资料带进对话
readme.text:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的每个项目配一个资料库。文档、图片、表格或其他项目文件，都可以放在一起管理；聊天时开启资料库模式，让 AI 按需参考其中的原文件。

资料保存在你指定的本机目录，按工作区分开整理。你可以在「资料库」菜单里查看和管理所有库，也可以在对话中选择这次要用哪些资料。

[下载最新版](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest) · [安装说明](#安装) · [开始使用](#首次使用) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/issues)

> 截图使用了自定义主题，背景与桌面装饰来自主题。本插件提供资料库功能。

readme.section: v1.0.1 更新 · 新对话默认通用模式
readme.text:
**新建对话不再默认开启资料库模式。** 平时直接聊天，需要参考项目文件时，再点击对话框里的资料范围入口，手动开启资料库模式。

已有对话保存的模式选择保持不变，资料库、已导入文件和存储位置均不受影响，无需重新导入。更新后请完整退出 DSH（包括托盘后台进程）再启动，确保新版前后端一起生效。

[查看本次更新与下载安装包](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

readme.section: 每个项目，资料各归各处
readme.text: 新工作区会自动建立独立资料库，已有工作区也可以创建或关联资料库。在统一管理页里，按库名、工作区或存储路径查找，按更新时间、名称或文件数排序，切换项目时也能找到对应的资料。
第一次使用时，选择一个本机文件夹作为资料存储目录。导入会把文件复制到资料库，保留来源文件夹里的原件。每个库都有自己的目录，方便统一保存和备份。

readme.section: 文件和文件夹，都能批量导入
readme.text: 支持任意格式文件的原件存储。点击选择或直接拖入多个文件、整个文件夹，先在弹窗里核对清单，再确认导入。导入过程中可以查看进度和逐文件结果，同名文件分别保存。

readme.section: 需要参考资料时，在对话里开启
readme.text: 新建对话默认使用**通用模式**，直接聊天即可。需要参考项目文件时，点击对话框里的资料范围入口，切换到资料库模式，AI 就能按授权范围查找并打开相关原件。开启后，默认参考当前工作区关联的资料库，也可以为这次会话额外授权其他库。已有对话保存的模式选择会继续保留。

readme.section: 哪些资料给 AI 用，随时可调整
readme.text: 文件可以单独纳入或排除 AI 参考，也可以下载原件、移入回收区或恢复。整理项目时，支持整库移入回收区、清空回收区，以及停用后删除资料库；永久删除前会要求输入名称确认。

当前正式版为 **1.0.1**，适配 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` 接口，声明兼容范围为 `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`，需要 Node.js ≥22.13.0。各宿主版本的验证情况见[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest) 下载 **`dsh-library-1.0.1.tgz`** 插件安装包。
2. 打开 DSH 的「插件」管理器，通过本地安装包入口安装并启用。如果宿主提供的是链接本地目录入口，先解压安装包，再选择其中包含 `package.json` 的 `package` 目录。
3. 完整退出 DSH，包括托盘里的后台进程，再启动并刷新页面。侧栏出现「资料库」就可以开始使用了。

升级时保留现有资料，先备份资料目录和 DSH profile，再安装新版本并完整重启。

1. **选好存储位置。** 打开「资料库 → 存储与隐私」，选择或填写运行 DSH 的电脑上的本机绝对路径，点击保存。
2. **确认文件使用授权。** 在同一页面确认是否允许模型按需使用整份原文件。
3. **放入项目资料。** 新工作区会自动建库；已有工作区可以先创建或关联资料库，再拖入文件或文件夹，核对清单并确认导入。
4. **开始提问。** 新建对话默认是通用模式。需要参考资料时，点击对话框里的资料范围入口，手动开启资料库模式，确认范围后直接描述你的问题。

例如，可以试着问：“项目里有哪些参考文档？”或“请根据库里的需求文档，整理这次要做的功能。”

<details>
<summary>看看菜单入口和对话设置</summary>

readme.section: 仅影响当前会话的授权范围
readme.text: </details>

资料先保存在本机，需要参考时，再由模型按授权范围打开相关原件。导入后即可管理文件，具体内容的读取由宿主、当前模型和可用工具完成；支持保存的格式与能够读取的格式有所区别。

使用云端模型时，打开文件可能将整份原件发送给模型，并留在会话附件和历史中。你可以关闭授权来停止后续交付；已经发送的内容仍保留在原会话中。请根据资料的敏感程度决定是否授权，存储目录也应放在 Git 仓库之外。

授权范围、附件交付和数据处理的详细说明见[使用细节与技术参考](docs/usage-reference.md#按需附件与隐私)及[安全说明](SECURITY.md)。

支持任意格式的原文件存储，文件夹可递归导入。单文件默认上限为 **50 MiB**，可在设置中调整为 **1–200 MiB**；每库最多 **2000 个文件**，包含回收区。

大批量导入、目录扫描和各类文件的使用方式，见[完整参数说明](docs/usage-reference.md#格式与边界)。
在资料库详情的「文件」页点击「全部移入回收区」，输入完整库名确认，即可把该库全部未回收文件移入回收区，包括已排除的文件。操作范围是整个库，与当前搜索或筛选无关；之后可以逐个恢复。
在「回收区」中，可以永久删除单个文件，也可以清空整个回收区。两种操作都会要求输入完整名称确认，确认后删除库内副本、释放对应空间。永久删除不可恢复，重要资料请先备份。

先停用资料库，再从详情页选择「删除资料库」。确认框会列出文件数量和本地目录，输入完整库名后，删除该库及其目录中的文件，来源文件夹里的原件保持原样。

删除中的异常处理与重试方式见[操作细节](docs/usage-reference.md#删除资料库)。

备份时，请同时保留**资料存储目录和 DSH profile**，这样才能保留原件以及资料库关联、授权等设置。修改存储根目录后，新建资料库会使用新位置，已有资料库继续保存在原处。

目录结构、元数据与恢复方式见[备份说明](docs/usage-reference.md#数据布局与备份)和[架构与恢复](docs/architecture.md)。

开发环境需要 Node.js 22.13+（建议 24 LTS）与 pnpm。

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run test:all
pnpm pack --pack-destination release
```

参与开发可查看[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)、[发布清单](docs/releasing.md)和[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。实现细节另见[技术参考](docs/usage-reference.md#开发与发布)。

本项目是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的非官方插件，不隶属于 DeepSeek。项目代码与原创书本图标采用 MIT 许可。

界面截图用于功能展示，其中第三方商标、主题背景和装饰素材归各自权利人所有。第三方依赖遵循各自许可证，详见[许可说明](docs/usage-reference.md#许可)。

readme.section: DSH Library · Bring your project files into the conversation
readme.text:
[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

Give every project in **DeepSeek Harness** its own library. Keep documents, images, spreadsheets, and other project files together, then turn on library mode in a conversation so AI can refer to the original files as needed.

Files stay in a local directory you choose, organized by workspace. Manage all your libraries from the Library menu, and choose which ones to use in each conversation.

readme.section: DSH Library · Bring your project files into the conversation
readme.text:
[Download](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest) · [Installation](#installation) · [Getting started](#getting-started) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/issues)

> The screenshots use a custom theme. The background and desktop decorations come from the theme; this plugin provides the library features. The management interface is currently in Chinese.

readme.section: v1.0.1 update · General mode by default
readme.text:
**New conversations no longer enable library mode by default.** Chat normally, then open the library scope control and enable library mode when you want to reference project files.

Existing conversations keep their saved mode choices. Libraries, imported files, and storage locations stay unchanged; no re-import is needed. After updating, fully quit DSH (including its system-tray background process) and restart it so the new client and backend take effect together.

readme.section: v1.0.1 update · General mode by default
readme.text: [Release notes and downloads](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

New workspaces get their own libraries automatically. For existing workspaces, create a library or link one you already have. The management page lets you find libraries by name, workspace, or storage path, and sort them by last updated, name, or file count.

On first use, choose a local folder for library storage. Importing copies files into the library and leaves the originals in their source folder. Each library has its own directory, making storage and backups easier to organize.

readme.section: Import files and folders in batches
readme.text: Store original files in any format. Select or drag in multiple files or entire folders, review the list in a dialog, and confirm the import. Follow progress and individual file results as they come in. Files with the same name are stored separately.

readme.section: Bring relevant files into the conversation
readme.text: New conversations start in **general mode**, ready for everyday chat. When you want to reference project files, open the library scope control in the conversation and switch to library mode. AI can then find and open authorized originals. Library mode uses the current workspace's linked library by default, and you can authorize additional libraries for that conversation. Existing conversations keep their saved mode choices.

readme.section: Decide which files AI can use
readme.text: Include or exclude individual files from AI reference, download originals, or move files to the recovery area and restore them later. For larger cleanups, move a library's files to the recovery area in one action, empty the recovery area, or deactivate and delete a library. Permanent deletion requires you to type the name to confirm.

The current stable release is **1.0.1**, targeting the DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` interface. The declared compatibility range is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`, with Node.js ≥22.13.0 required. See the [validation notes](docs/validation.md) for host-version testing details.

1. Download the **`dsh-library-1.0.1.tgz`** plugin package from [Releases](https://github.com/wuzeno/dsh-library/releases/latest).
2. Open the DSH plugin manager, install the local package, and enable it. If your host offers a local-directory linking option instead, extract the package and select the `package` folder containing `package.json`.
3. Fully quit DSH, including its background process in the system tray. Start it again and refresh the page. Look for **资料库** (Library) in the sidebar.
When upgrading, keep your existing files. Back up both the library storage directory and your DSH profile, install the new version, and fully restart DSH.

1. **Choose a storage location.** Open **资料库 → 存储与隐私** (Library → Storage & Privacy), select or enter an absolute local path on the computer running DSH, and save it.
2. **Confirm file access.** On the same page, choose whether to allow the model to use complete original files on demand.
3. **Add your project files.** New workspaces get libraries automatically. For an existing workspace, create or link a library, drag in files or folders, review the list, and confirm.
4. **Ask a question.** New conversations start in general mode. To reference project files, open the library scope control, enable library mode, check which libraries are in scope, and describe what you need.

For example: “What reference documents are in this project?” or “Use the requirements document in the library to summarize the features we need to build.”

<details>
<summary>See the menu and conversation settings</summary>

readme.section: Set access for the current conversation
readme.text: </details>

Files are stored locally first. When needed, the model opens relevant originals within the scope you authorize. You can manage files as soon as they are imported; reading their contents depends on the host, current model, and available tools. A format that can be stored may not be readable by your current setup.

When using a cloud model, opening a file may send the complete original to the model and retain it in conversation attachments and history. Turning off access stops future delivery; content already sent remains in the original conversation. Consider the sensitivity of your files before granting access, and keep your library storage directory outside Git repositories.
For details on authorization, attachment delivery, and data handling, see the [technical reference](docs/usage-reference.md#按需附件与隐私) and [security notes](SECURITY.md).

Store original files in any format and import folders recursively. The default per-file limit is **50 MiB**, configurable from **1–200 MiB**. Each library holds up to **2,000 files**, including those in the recovery area.

See the [full limits and behavior](docs/usage-reference.md#格式与边界) for batch imports, folder scanning, and file handling.

readme.section: Move all files to the recovery area
readme.text: In a library's **文件** (Files) tab, click **全部移入回收区** (Move all to recovery area) and enter the full library name to confirm. This moves all files that are not already in the recovery area, including excluded files. It applies to the whole library, regardless of the current search or filter. You can restore files individually afterward.

readme.section: Permanently delete files from the recovery area
readme.text: In **回收区** (Recovery area), permanently delete individual files or empty the entire recovery area. Both actions require the full name to confirm and delete the library's copies to free the corresponding disk space. Permanent deletion cannot be undone, so back up important files first.

Deactivate the library, then choose **删除资料库** (Delete library) on its detail page. The confirmation dialog shows the file count and local directory. Enter the full library name to delete the library and the files in its directory. Originals in the source folder stay untouched.

See the [operation details](docs/usage-reference.md#删除资料库) for error handling and retries.

Back up **both the library storage directory and your DSH profile** to preserve original files along with library links, permissions, and other settings. After you change the storage root, new libraries use the new location; existing libraries stay where they are.

See the [backup reference](docs/usage-reference.md#数据布局与备份) and [architecture and recovery notes](docs/architecture.md) for directory structure, metadata, and recovery details.

Development requires Node.js 22.13+ (24 LTS recommended) and pnpm.

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run test:all
pnpm pack --pack-destination release
```

See the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), [release checklist](docs/releasing.md), and [validation notes](docs/validation.md). Implementation details are in the [technical reference](docs/usage-reference.md#开发与发布).

The linked supporting documents are currently in Chinese.

This is an unofficial plugin for DeepSeek Harness and is not affiliated with DeepSeek. The project code and original book icon are MIT-licensed.

Screenshots illustrate the features. Third-party trademarks, theme backgrounds, and decorative assets belong to their respective owners. Dependencies retain their own licenses; see the [license details](docs/usage-reference.md#许可).
